Ltd. (hereafter referred to as “3RI Technologies Pvt. Ltd.”,”3RI” “we”, “us”, or “our”) is a Training academy based in Pune offering classroom training to students. The Courses offered at 3RI are intended but not limited to individuals to upgrade their skills and gain additional qualifications to increase the chance of employability. The course content is a property of 3RI and is available on our website. We update our course from time to time ensuring a better learning experience for students. The management reserves the right to make changes to the course without any notice. Admission Terms: The course admission at 3RI is governed by certain eligibility criteria and selection norms which are easily accessible with the counselor. Students are expected to participate in the selection/eligibility evaluation process, to ensure ease of future learning. Some of the courses have few prerequisites and we assume that the student has completed some academic studies. Though we make an effort to educate the student, it is the student’s responsibility to be aware of the prior knowledge requirements for admission into the course. The admission to the course once done, is not transferable to any other individual. It is the student’s responsibility to go through all the T&Cs before completing the enrollment process. The student should understand the contents of the course/program. 3RI will not be liable to provide any services beyond the admitted course duration. Copyright & Intellectual Property: The entire site content has been developed by us and is protected by copyright and trademark laws. Other materials on the website like Logo, images, videos, etc. are copyrighted and is a property of 3RI Technologies Pvt. Ltd. We completely understand the value of the property and believe that the usage or breach of it for any reasons without approval must not happen. Nobody is allowed to use any of our images, content, or logo without written consent from 3RI management. 3RI has all the rights to take any action that can be (but not limited to) prohibit access to the website etc. Course Fee Policy: All courses fee mentioned on our website or 3rd party sites is subject to change from time to time without any notice. We reserve the right to change the course fee and these changes can be due to many reasons like change in market conditions, manual errors, 3rd party service providers, etc. However, the fee paid by a student at the time of enrollment will still hold up for you.
